description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Gangodagama, Weligepola D/S Division, Ratnapura District (25/0285)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, registration of landowners, and cadastral information under the Registration of Title Act. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land ownership, title settlement, and property registration without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
